title: Script NAT Transparant Proxy & Squid
comment: #!/bin/sh # squid server IP SQUID_SERVER="192.168.1.1" # Interface connected to Internet INTERNET="eth0" # Interface connected to LAN LAN_IN="eth1" # Squid port SQUID_PORT="3128" # DO NOT MODIFY BELOW # Clean old firewall iptables -F iptables -X iptables -t nat -F iptables -t nat -X iptables -t mangle -F iptables -t mangle -X # Load IPTABLES modules for NAT and IP conntrack support modprobe
